notes.body:
# A new look

Exit Only now opens like a full game, with a new logo and icon.

- A start-up intro with the Arcnode logo and a title that slams in under police lights
- A new Exit Only logo, and an app icon made from it
- A short privacy and photosensitivity notice before you play

Any key moves through the intro and Esc skips it. You can turn it off in Settings.
